name: Supernatural Investigations
source:
You’ve got a great life as a young, smart, motorcycle-riding detective woman working for the city PD homicide unit. All seems perfect, and you’re even up for a promotion…that is until the chief-of-police transfers you down to a secret division in the basement that you never knew existed: The Special-Task Division…
This division includes five men, including your new boss, and three of your new colleagues are disturbingly hot! What’s even more disturbing is that this secret team deals with murders involving supernatural beings…going against your strong sense of science and logic! As you work on three cases that involve urban legends and impossible-seeming paranormal activity, your resistance to believe in such things breaks down, and you feel like you’re going crazy. To add to the madness, the 3 gorgeous new co-detectives all start falling for you!
As a fourth supernatural homicide case appears, one involving a vampire with daily kills, the entire Special-Task Division is at risk of being shut down for good, unless you all catch the murdering monster. The problem is, you suspect it’s someone on the inside…someone in your new unit. When it’s clear you are the vampire’s next target, you have to figure out who to trust, and how to stay alive!


As you delve into this fun, thrilling and deathly supernatural story, you have the power to make choices of all kinds, from simple to complicated to downright lethal! And after getting to know your three new detective colleagues, you get to make the final choice…which beautiful man is right for you?
translation:
你是一名年輕聰明、騎著機車的女警探，在市警局兇案組工作，生活過得有聲有色。一切似乎都很完美，你甚至即將升職……直到警察局長把你調去了地下室裡一個你從未聽說過的秘密部門：特別任務組……
這個部門有五名男性，包括你的新上司，其中三位新同事帥得讓人心神不寧！更令你不安的是，這個秘密小組負責調查涉及超自然生物的兇殺案……這與你一貫信奉的科學與邏輯完全相悖！隨著三起涉及都市傳說和看似不可能發生的靈異現象的案件逐步展開，你原本堅定的不信態度開始瓦解，甚至覺得自己快要瘋了。更讓人招架不住的是，那三位英俊的新搭檔竟然都開始對你動心！
第四起超自然兇殺案接踵而至，一隻吸血鬼每天都在殺人。除非你們抓住這個殺人怪物，否則整個特別任務組都將被永久撤銷。問題在於，你懷疑兇手就藏在內部……就在你剛加入的這個小組裡。當你確定自己成了吸血鬼的下一個目標，你必須弄清楚誰值得信任，又該如何活下去！


深入這個趣味十足、驚險又致命的超自然故事，你將做出各式各樣的選擇：有的簡單，有的複雜，有的甚至直接關乎生死！而在瞭解三位新警探同事之後，你還將迎來最終的選擇……究竟哪位美男子才是你的真命天子？
